Pakistan Army Chief Asim Munir Appointed to Population Control Panel

Pakistan's government has appointed Army Chief Asim Munir to a high-level committee tasked with addressing the country's growing population crisis. Health Minister Abdul Qadir Patel stated that the government is prioritizing population control and making significant policy decisions. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif formed the committee to tackle the issue. Munir's inclusion expands his influence beyond defense.
